top_signals.title: China Fund Closures Head for Eight-Year High as Demand Fades
top_signals.summary: China’s mutual funds are closing at the fastest pace in eight years as weak returns and investor redemptions leave hundreds of products too small to survive.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Brazil votes in high-stakes election as U.S.-China rivalry and debt loom large
top_signals.summary: Brazil will hold a knife-edge vote as its presidential race kicks off — but the election's outcome is likely to be felt far beyond the country's borders.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
